During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier]] with a picture of a snarling [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] on the front of it saw service with the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. A number of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] gave the vehicle the nickname '''''Wampa Runner'''''.

{{Veh-stub}}

==History==
''Wampa Runner'' was use to transport an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] in the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion's]] [[Battle of Teth/Legends|assault]] on [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] to rescue [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] son.
